definitions.full: H6270. Athlay עַתְלָ֑י עֲתַלְיָ֫ה(וּׅ, proper name, feminine and masculine (? ׳י is exalted ); — 1. feminine Athaliah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel, mother of Ahaziah king of Judah ; Γοθολια : יָהוּ - 2Kin 8:26 ; 11:2 , 20 2Chr 22:2 , 10 , 11 ; 23:12-13 , 21 ; 24:7 ; יָה - 2Kin 11:1 , 3 , 13 , 14 ; 2Chr 22:12 . 2. masculine a. 1Chr 8:26 Ογοθολια . b. Ezra 8:7 Αθελει , A Αθλια ; ᵐ5 L Γοθονίου (genitive). c. עַתְלָ֑י one with foreign wife Ezra 10:28 , Θαλι , A Οθαλι .
